svg.title: Workshop the Pattern
svg.desc: Sketch in perspective: a table seen from its front corner, with a hatched pattern card lying on it. In front of the table, one mannequin reader points at the card; behind the table, a second reader leans in with a pencil over it. Off to the right, the author stands apart with a hand cupped to one ear. The table and card are a pattern workshop: a new pattern set out for others to read before it leaves draft, and the card is the focus. The two readers are the solution's "at least two readers besides its author". The pointing reader is saying what works, which comes first; the reader with the pencil is saying what could be better, which comes second. The author standing apart and listening is the rule that the author listens first and asks questions only at the end. The metaphor: a pattern as a piece of craft set on a bench for others to inspect, with its maker stepping back.
